Subject: Preflight: Redwood + Atlas webinar — registration + streaming mapping

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Quick intro — Ben from BrightStage Events here. We're the platform partner running the ON24/Zoom hybrid bridge for the Redwood x Atlas Security webinar on Sept 9. Attaching our standard preflight template (BrightStage_preflight_template.xlsx).

Two asks to sync on before we schedule the platform run-through:
- Confirm the exact registration fields you want passed to ON24 and Zoom (we often see mismatches on "company role" vs "job title").
- Confirm sponsor release + recording retention expectations (we'll need a signed release before post-event clips are shared).
- Any region fallback preference for streaming if primary US encoder overloads? We can fail over to EU but need a heads-up for latency expectations.

Can you confirm by EOD Thursday? If helpful we can do a 30-min preflight call this week (we've found those save time on day-of issues).

Attachments: BrightStage_preflight_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Ben Watson
Operations Lead, BrightStage Events
ops@brightstage.dev

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Watson <ops@brightstage.dev>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preflight: Redwood + Atlas webinar — registration + streaming mapping

Thanks Ben — appreciate the template. High level answers up front:
- Registration fields: we want canonical fields for first name, last name, company, job_title, email, country, and a single opt-in consent checkbox (GDPR-friendly text). We also need a hidden field for lead_source=sponsor_atlas.
- Recording: Redwood retains raw recordings for 30 days by default; sponsor clips can be delivered after a signed release. Please surface any additional clause we should expect.
- Failover: primary US encoder, fallback EU is acceptable — please aim for a warm standby so failover is <20s.

Action items:
1) Marissa — can you produce a field mapping spreadsheet that maps BrightStage form names -> Redwood CRM fields -> ON24/Zoom target fields? (I put you as owner)
2) Tessa — please confirm retention & clip-extraction steps; we need a runnable ops checklist for day-of.
3) Ben — please propose two 30-min timeslots (Wed/Thu afternoon PT) for a preflight call.

I'll schedule the call once we have proposed times.

-r

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Watson <ops@brightstage.dev>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preflight: Redwood + Atlas webinar — registration + streaming mapping

Attaching a draft mapping: redwood_reg_field_map.xlsx. Summary below so it's searchable in thread: 

- BrightStage "FirstName" -> Redwood first_name -> ON24 fname (OK)
- BrightStage "LastName" -> Redwood last_name -> ON24 lname (OK)
- BrightStage "CompanyName" -> Redwood company -> ON24 company (OK)
- BrightStage "Role/Title" -> Redwood job_title -> ON24 title (note: BrightStage has free-text; we'll normalize to 80 chars)
- BrightStage "Country" -> Redwood country -> ON24 country_code (we'll map to ISO2)
- BrightStage "Consent" (checkbox) -> Redwood consent_flag -> ON24 opt_in (we'll include consent wording per legal below)
- Hidden: lead_source=sponsor_atlas -> Redwood utm_source (for CRM attribution)

Notes / acceptance criteria:
- All fields must arrive in ON24 at time of session join (not just post-reg). BrightStage: confirm whether Zoom registration API vs ON24 native mapping will be used — prefer ON24 native for registrant-scoped engagement analytics.
- Job title truncation: if >80 chars, BrightStage should send full text to Redwood CRM and a truncated copy to ON24.
- We will not collect phone number.

Attachment: redwood_reg_field_map.xlsx (xlsx)
Marissa Cole
Sr. Events Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preflight: Redwood + Atlas webinar — registration + streaming mapping

Adding ops checklist and signature/DocuSign steps — see summary below and attached ops_preflight_checklist.pdf.

Day-of ops checklist (high level):
- 60m before: verify ON24 session settings, confirm registrant count and leader role assignment.
- 45m before: validate stream key & encoder health (primary US encoder warmed, EU on standby). Record baseline latency number.
- 30m before: run audio/video loop test with speaker(s). Confirm closed captions source.
- 15m before: start recording in both ON24 and Zoom (redundant). Confirm that both recordings are being uploaded to BrightStage S3 (if allowed).
- Post-event (within 48h): extract sponsor clips and deliver only after sponsor release is signed. We WILL NOT publish sponsor clips until DocuSign is executed.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF123456 (sponsor_release_v1.pdf attached). Laura — can you do a quick legal spot-check and confirm if the 30-day raw retention + sponsor delivery policy looks OK?

Attachment: ops_preflight_checklist.pdf (pdf), sponsor_release_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Events Producer, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com
